note: Muscle memory and G3 pattern recognition, first form (step P8; specification 3 and 5.3). Read by nmmusc::Policy; a missing file or field keeps the fallback in code (gate z 1.96, withdrawal z 1.96, store dir muscle). The two z values are fixed test gates; every other operating number is derived at run time from the behaviour log, as described in the rule fields.

miner.method: contiguous chunks scored by compression gain, occurrences times (length - 1) minus (length + 1); idea from Stitch, arXiv 2211.16605
miner.recurrence_rule: occurrences >= 2 and M * P(Poisson(E) >= occurrences) < 1, E from the log's own symbol frequencies, M the distinct chunks examined in the pass; gain > 0

gate.estimator: split means: traces with the chunk against traces without, Welch standard error

withdrawal.rule: change rule (2026-11-18, T-042): Page's CUSUM of (promotion gain / 2 - gain) scaled by promotion gain / per-use variance is the log likelihood ratio of 'gains nothing' against 'still gains'; withdraw when it passes ln(n (n + 1) / alpha), alpha = P(Z > z), n the uses; the per-use variance pools the promotion's (se^2 * with_n) with the observed uses'

pack.payload: alphabet indices at the smallest width (1, 2 or 4 bytes) that holds the pack's alphabet
pack.vectors: reserved section for encoded behavioural vectors, empty in the first form
